mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT CUSTOM_TEAM_ID, USER_ID, TEAM_NAME, FORMATION, CREATED_AT FROM CUSTOM_TEAMS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT S.SQUAD_ID, S.CUSTOM_TEAM_ID, S.PLAYER_ID, NVL(P.NAME_KOR, P.NAME) AS PLAYER_NAME, S.POSITION_NO, P.MAIN_POSITION FROM CUSTOM_SQUADS S JOIN PLAYERS P ON P.PLAYER_ID = S.PLAYER_ID WHERE S.CUSTOM_TEAM_ID = #{customTeamId} ORDER BY S.POSITION_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CUSTOM_TEAMS (USER_ID, TEAM_NAME, FORMATION, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{teamName}, #{formation}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
